subject: QBR + Roadmap Demo — proposal: split-block mini-sessions to accommodate exec windows
messages:
From: Emily Cho <emily@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Health Procurement <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing constraints from exec team

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the heads-up on the upcoming QBR. Our execs have two unavoidable all-hands blocks on the 20th and 21st (PST) which makes a single 90-minute slot difficult. We still want the roadmap walkthrough and a concise technical demo for the engineering leads.

Two asks:
- Can you propose a way to break the session into shorter, targeted blocks so we can pull in execs for the 20–30 minute roadmap highlights and keep a separate 30–45 minute technical deep-dive for engineering?
- Procurement would like a preliminary pricing attachment and a copy of the demo agenda they can review with stakeholders.

If possible please include backup options the week of May 24 in case slots hit conflicts.

Best,
Emily
Emily Cho
Director, Strategic Programs
BrightPath Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing constraints from exec team

Emily — thanks for the constraints and the ask. Totally doable and happy to propose a split-block format that tends to work well for cross-functional attendees. Quick proposal below (also attaching a draft agenda + pricing sheet):

Proposal: split-block QBR (single calendar invite w/ two physical sessions)
- 20-minute Executive Highlights (roadmap top-line, business outcomes, renewal ask) — keep to C-level + procurement
- 40-minute Technical Deep Dive (modeling choices, perf benchmarks, ops-runbook) — for engineers and platform leads
- 15-minute Q&A / Decision Items — overlap attendees who need to cross between sessions

Suggested slots (all PT):
A) May 20 — Exec Highlights 10:00–10:20, Tech Deep Dive 10:30–11:10
B) May 21 — Exec Highlights 14:00–14:20, Tech Deep Dive 14:30–15:10
C) Backup: May 25 — condensed half-day 09:00–11:00 (if more latitude needed)

Marissa, can you own the recording + slide deck distribution? Grace — can you lead the technical deep-dive and include a 5–10 minute walkthrough of the KV cache & batching recommendations? Sergio — I'll ask you to surface any outstanding SLA questions that procurement might press on.

Emily — attached: QBR-agenda-v2.pdf (draft), redwood-pricing-sheet-annual.xlsx (starter), demo-runbook-notes.md. I can shorten the pricing summary to a one-pager if procurement prefers.

If those first two slots won't work, tell us the earliest time your execs can make a 20-minute block and we'll pivot.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: procurement@brightpathhealth.com <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Emily Cho <emily@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing constraints from exec team

Ben / Emily — procurement here. A couple of notes: we need a pricing one-sheet that shows committed monthly and annual equivalents (TCO view) and a short note on data residency / audit logs to include in our compliance packet. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide SOC2 evidence and the default retention window for trace logs?

Also: we prefer the May 25 backup if the exec timeboxes on the 20/21 get locked. If you send a DocuSign with a non-binding SOW summary that outlines scope for the demo + a quote line, we can accelerate internal approvals.

Procurement (BrightPath)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: procurement@brightpathhealth.com <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Emily Cho <emily@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing constraints from exec team

Hi procurement team — quick answers:
- SOC 2: yes, Redwood can provide a current SOC 2 Type II report — I'll attach the redacted version to the HubSpot record and share via secure link.
- Trace logs / retention: default is 90 days for request/response logs; we offer extended retention as an add-on and can document retention policies in the SOW.

Ben — I can fold a 5-slide compliance appendix into the Exec Highlights and leave a short pointer in the agenda to the SOC2 link.

Grace
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily@brightpathhealth.com>, procurement@brightpathhealth.com <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_occonnor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — timing constraints from exec team

Thanks everyone — quick status update and next steps:
- Emily: you've confirmed preference for the May 25 backup; I'm holding A & B tentatively but will make May 25 the firm slot as of now.
- Marissa: please publish the slides and the recording bucket for the session.
- Grace: please prepare the technical appendix (KV cache, batching, quantization choices) and a 2-slide summary for procurement on security/retention.
- Sergio: add a single slide that lists SLA targets and escalation contacts.

I'll send a calendar invite for May 25 09:00–11:00 PT with two blocks inside the invite (Exec Highlights 09:00–09:25, Tech Deep Dive 09:30–10:15, Q&A 10:15–10:30, buffer/ops 10:30–11:00).

Attachments for procurement and Emily: 1) QBR-agenda-v2.pdf 2) redwood-pricing-sheet-annual.xlsx 3) demo-runbook-notes.md  (attached here as stubs).

Ben

From: Emily Cho <emily@brightpathhealth.com>

Ben — that works for us. May 25 09:00–11:00 PT is confirmed on our side. A couple quick items before the session:
- Please include a 5-minute recorded recap for folks who can't join live (we'll rely on that for execs in APAC).
- Procurement, thanks — once we have the one-pager we'll kick the internal approval.

See you then —Emily
